slgRoot: An inferred symbolic repeat has an unsized array type with no type-level extent name hash. The clone substitutes type-level N extents but leaves this expression count unsized; ordinary emission therefore sees one seed operand.
chosenFix: During the same concrete body specialization, resolve the count against the owning compile-time value parameter and intern the concrete fixed-array type through the existing semantic type interner. Ordinary array emission then consumes this canonical type; no runtime loop or emitter fallback is restored.
